meta.scope_note: Speaking & Listening and Writing strands only, grades 6 through 11-12 (five bands: 6, 7, 8, 9-10, 11-12) -- not Reading (Literature or Informational Text) or Language, and not K-5. California's own CCSS adoption (the 2013 ELA/Literacy framework) keeps this same numbering verbatim, so this catalog serves both a national and a California-specific citation.
meta.codes_note: Codes are CCSS's own (e.g. SL.6.1, W.9-10.1), not a project-specific scheme. The lettered sub-parts some standards carry officially (e.g. W.6.1.a-e) are folded into one paraphrase per numbered standard here, matching this project's existing topic-level (not sub-EK-level) citation granularity elsewhere (see apcsp.json's own topic/LO split).

items.name: Comprehension and Collaboration
items.paraphrase: Take part effectively in collaborative discussions with varied partners on grade 6 topics, building on others' ideas and expressing your own clearly.

items.name: Comprehension and Collaboration
items.paraphrase: Interpret information presented in diverse media and formats (visual, quantitative, oral) and explain how it contributes to a topic.

items.name: Comprehension and Collaboration
